source.description: One reviewed six-panel graphite-and-colored-pencil contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one right-facing dragonfly perched sideways on one vertical cattail stem with exactly four transparent wings, six bent legs, a segmented abdomen, one seed head, and restrained summer color.

process_strategy: Reserve the cattail, body axis, four wing envelopes, six leg routes, and broken shadow in pale construction; convert those same guides into persistent contours; stop the stem behind the dragonfly's body and gripping legs; add veins, texture, and color before limiting the final panel to keeper-line and shading cleanup.

final_elements.name: pale cattail dragonfly wing leg and shadow construction
final_elements.description: A vertical cattail stem and seed-head envelope, one right-facing dragonfly body axis, four wing envelopes, six bent leg routes, and a broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: cattail stem seed head and segmented dragonfly body contours
final_elements.description: One narrow stem with a single brown seed head plus a stable dragonfly head, thorax, and tapered segmented abdomen.

final_elements.name: four transparent wing contours and six bent legs
final_elements.description: Exactly four long transparent wings and six bent legs, with four contacting the stem and two balancing beneath the thorax without changing the body pose.

final_elements.name: wing-cell veins body bands cattail texture and broken shadow
final_elements.description: A simplified persistent wing-cell rhythm, abdomen bands, short cattail hatching, and one broken graphite shadow.

final_elements.name: restrained teal rust and olive colored-pencil accents
final_elements.description: Sparse teal on the body, rust on the seed head, and olive on the stem with open paper preserved in the wings.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The cattail stem stops behind the dragonfly thorax and each gripping leg, while the rear wing bases stop beneath the established body instead of being drawn through and erased later.

rejection_checks: Keep one right-facing dragonfly, one vertical cattail, one pose, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
Keep exactly four wings and six legs after those routes appear; no wing, leg, seed head, body segment, or shadow may disappear and return.
The cattail stem and rear wing bases must stop at reserved foreground silhouettes; no keeper line may be erased to fake a grip or overlap.
Do not add a flower, pond, second insect, extra plant, lettering, label, arrow, number, signature, watermark, or decorative border.
The final panel may not introduce a wing, leg, vein region, body band, texture cluster, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must look like tactile graphite and colored pencil on warm paper, not glossy insect art, photorealism, or rasterized vector illustration.
